01

“let not pity for them take hold of you in the religion of God”

Three explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr (Q 24:2).

707
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 707: 1: 9

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
707: 1:9. Sufyan, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, on His words
"let not pity for them take hold of you in the religion of God": He said, suspending the penalty (verse 2).
العربية
707: 1: 9 سفيان عن بن أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي قوله تَأْخُذْكُمْ بِهِمَا رَأْفَةٌ فِي دِينِ الله قاله تعطيل الحد (الآية 2) .

Explanation from Mujāhid No. 708: 2: 2

English

"and let a group of the believers witness their punishment": He said, a group is one man or more (verse 2).

708: 2: 2 سفيان عن بن أَبِي نَجِيحٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ وَلْيَشْهَدْ عذابهما طائفة من المؤمنين قَالَ الطَّائِفَةُ رَجُلٌ فَمَا زَادَ (الاية 2) .

02

“The fornicator does not marry except a fornicatress or an idolatress”

Two explanations transmitted from Mujāhid ibn Jabr and Ibn ʿAbbās (Q 24:3).

710
Explanation from Mujāhid No. 710: 4: 1

Mujāhid ibn Jabr

English
Transmission wording
710: 4:1. Sufyan related to us, from Salama ibn Kuhayl, from Mujahid, who said:
This verse was revealed: "The fornicator does not marry except a fornicatress or an idolatress." He said, it was revealed about known women in Medina who were called baghiyyat [prostitutes] or luqayat (Abu Jafar was unsure of the transmission); it was revealed about them specifically (verse 3).
العربية
710: 4: 1 حدثنا سفيان عَنْ سَلَمَةَ بْنِ كُهَيْلٍ عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ لا يَنْكِحُ إِلا زَانِيَةً أَوْ مشركة قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِي نِسَاءٍ مَعْلُومَاتٍ بِالْمَدِينَةِ كَانَ يُقَالُ لَهُنَّ بَغِيَّاتٌ أو لقيات روى الشَّكُّ مِنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ نَزَلَتْ فيهن خاصة (الآية 3) .
Edition record 371459 · p. 220Link to report ↗
711
Report from Ibn ʿAbbās No. 711: 5: 10

Ibn ʿAbbās

English
Transmission wording
711: 5:10. Sufyan, from Hammad, from Said ibn Jubayr, from Ibn Abbas, on His words
"the fornicator does not marry except": He said, it does not mean lawful marriage but intercourse.
العربية
711: 5: 10 سفيان عَنْ حَمَّادٍ عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جبير عن بن عباس في قوله لا ينكح الا زانية قَالَ لَيْسَ هُوَ بِالنِّكَاحِ الْحَلالِ ولكن الجماع.
Edition record 371460 · p. 221Link to report ↗

04

“Chaste, dignified, no suspicion attaches to her; / she wakes up…”

Two explanations transmitted from Abū al-Ḍuḥā and Masrūq (Q 24:11).

713
Explanation from Abū al-Ḍuḥā No. 713: 7: 12

Abū al-Ḍuḥā

English
Transmission wording
713: 7:12. Sufyan, from al-Amash, from Abu al-Duha, who said:
Masruq entered upon Aisha, and Hassan was with her, reciting to her the verse of Hassan: "Chaste, dignified, no suspicion attaches to her; / she wakes up hungry from the flesh of heedless women" ⦗p. 222⦘ So I said to her, "Why do you let this man enter your house when he is among those who took on the greater share of it?" She said, "Do you not see that a great punishment has befallen him?" (verse 11).
العربية
الإسناد
713: 7: 12 سفيان عَنِ الْأَعْمَشِ عَنْ أَبِي الضُّحَى قال دخل مسروق عاى عايشة وَعِنْدَهَا حَسَّانٌ يُنْشِدُهَا شِعْرَ حَسَّانٍ حَصَانٌ رَزَانٌ مَا تُزَنُّ بِرِيبَةٍ وَتُصْبِحُ غَرْثَى مِنْ لُحُومِ الْغَوَافِلِ
"report__pb">⦗p. 222⦘ فَقُلْتُ لَهَا مَا تَدَعِينَ هَذَا يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْكِ وَهُوَ مِنَ الَّذِينَ تَوَلَّى كِبْرَهُ قَالَتْ أَفَلَا تَرَاهُ قد أصابه عذاب عظيم (الآية 11) .
Edition record 371460 371461 · pp. 221–222Link to report ↗

English

07

“and let not those of virtue and wealth among you swear not to give”

An explanation transmitted from Sufyān al-Thawrī (Q 24:22).

717
Explanation from Sufyān No. 717: 11: 21

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
717: 11:21. Sufyan:
"and let not those of virtue and wealth among you swear not to give": He said, Umm Mistah was with Aisha, and Umm Mistah said, "Mistah is ruined." ⦗p. 223⦘ Aisha said, "Why do you say this about a man of the Emigrants?" Umm Mistah said, "Do you not know what has been said?" Mistah was among those who had spoken about Aisha. He was an orphan in the care of Abu Bakr, and Abu Bakr said, "I will not benefit him in little or much." He said: So there was revealed this verse: "And let not those of virtue and wealth among you swear not to give to relatives, the needy, and the emigrants in the cause of God; let them pardon and overlook," to the end of the verse (verse 22).
العربية
717: 11: 21 سفيان ولا يأتل أولوا الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَنْ يُؤْتُوا قَالَ كَانَتْ أُمُّ مِسْطَحٍ عِنْدَ عايشة فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ مِسْطَحٍ تَعِسَ مِسْطَحٌ ⦗p. 223⦘ فقالت عايشة لم تقولين هذا الرجل مِنَ الْمُهَاجِرِينَ فَقَالَتْ أُمُّ مِسْطَحٍ أَمَا تَعْلَمِينَ مَا قَدْ قِيلَ وَكَانَ مِسْطَحٌ فِي مَنْ قَالَ في عايشة وَكَانَ يَتِيمًا فِي حِجْرِ أَبِي بَكْرٍ فَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ لَا أنفعه يقليل ولا كَثِيرٍ قَالَ فَنَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآيَةُ ولا يأتل أولوا الْفَضْلِ مِنْكُمْ وَالسَّعَةِ أَنْ يُؤْتُوا أُولِي الْقُرْبَى وَالْمَسَاكِينَ وَالْمُهَاجِرِينَ فِي سبيل الله وليعفوا وليصفحوا الى آخر الآية (الآية 22) .
Edition record 371461 371462 · pp. 222–223Link to report ↗

Explanation from Sufyān No. 718: 12: 4

Sufyān al-Thawrī

English
Transmission wording
718: 12:4. Sufyan: One who heard Said ibn Jubayr told me that he said: This verse was revealed specifically about Aisha:
"Indeed, those who accuse chaste, unaware, believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter" (verse 23).
